summary: Documentation: a maintainer page, docs/maintainers/agent-delivery.md, records how agent-built changes are planned, briefed, implemented, reviewed and merged here. It names the coordinator, implementer, reviewer and planner roles with their current default models, the loop for one change (a brief, a local implementation with a self-check, a draft pull request so hosted CI runs the full unit and browser suites while an independent read-only review runs, review rounds in which the first reports every finding, and ready and merge only when nothing blocks and CI is green), what a brief and a review brief contain, which checks run locally and which in CI, the timing rules (once, at the end, on a quiet machine, in alternating pairs), the self-check list built from recurring review findings, versioning and merging, and the local machine rules (port 3777, single Playwright specs on a free port 3107, no installs in worktrees, link farms). AGENTS.md links to it from its subagent and testing section.
warning: Not breaking. Documentation only: no code, schema, output, storage or agent tool change.

checklist.schema: No schema change. UPID, post schema, engine API, CAD document and save envelope are unchanged.
checklist.events: No execution event, input-version or cancellation change.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. WebMCP tools, their arguments, results and discovery are unchanged.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Nothing is migrated or rewritten.
checklist.verification: Documentation only. check-release, the documentation check and the pull request naming check pass; the new page's relative links resolve.
